summary: Compose causal thread privacy with main's storage readers through version 27

replay.detail: Preserve authoritative thread, message, operation and pairing history; no replay or history rewrite is required.

schema.detail: After graph schema initialization, application stores advance supported versions 20, 21, 22, 25, 26 and 27 to privacy floor 28. Main's blob-file, compacted-signature and replica-record readers remain supported. Plain graph stores retain the version-20 default. The application explicitly activates the reference writer behind the new fence.

rules.detail: Causal thread read privacy and separate fleet writer-readiness attestation remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Floor 28 fences every pre-privacy reader, including main's readers through version 27. Versions 23 and 24 remain unused and unsupported. Version-23 stores from unmerged preview builds are refused by the existing unsupported-schema path; there is no 23-to-28 migration.

downtime.detail: Source integration does not deploy services or enable thread writers.

manual.detail: Before rollout, verify no store uses preview version 23 or 24 and retain the existing separate reader-readiness and writer-enable approvals.

recovery.detail: Do not lower an upgraded store's user_version. Older binaries refuse floor 28; use a compatible forward repair or an explicitly authorized stopped restore of a consistent pre-upgrade backup.
